The Man with the Withered Hand

Richard Crashaw (G.) (c. 1613–1649)

M
ARK III.
 
3–5
.
T
AKE
 hold of Christ, O wretched one,
And with Christ take salvation.
But thy right hand, thou say’st, is dead;
Yet take thee hold: His word is said.
